column2: Clause 21: This clause replaces PART IV of the principal enactment, and the legal effect of the

column1: new PART IV (sections 24,25,26, 26a, 26b, 26c, 26d and 27) is to provide for-

column2: the  procedure  applicable  for  asserting  an  anti-doping  rule  violation  against  an
athlete or other Person and conducting a hearing by the Disciplinary Panel;
the appointment of an Appeal Panel and hearing of appeals by the Appeal Panel;
preferring appeals to the Court of Arbitration for Sport; and
the consequences of an adverse decision by the Appeal Panel.
